In particular those with mental health difficulties.Ive had an awful few days after having my urgent boods cancelled and being told by the receptionist "do u know you, you are always complaining" as well as other rude things. Doctor then dismissed the urgency for bloody test despite having dehydrated kidneys that was picked up 4 weeks ago and taking toxic meds that need to be monitored closely.Practice manager phoned me blaming me for upsetting rude receptionist when she hadn't even listened to the call. Practise manager then refused to book me in with mental health specialist. I am incensed by the behaviour of all involved  in this situation.I couldn't even voice my concerns on their website as the option has been disabled.I guess there is a reason why this practice only has 2 stars.It would seem that the rot runs right through the Practise as they are all covering each other's backs. I am sad and disappointed that in this day and age certain doctors are not taking the care of mental health patients seriously. I spent my weekend trying to come down from this awful treatment.I know that their will be people who defend the practice but in my opinion thet have no time for patients with mental illness which I feel extremely let down and discriminated against. On a more positive note I am doing a sponsored walk for Mind 100 miles in 31 days.At least I feel like like Im doing something towards a brighter future for those who struggle their way through life. I definitely wouldnt recommend this surgery to my worst enemy.

I contacted the practice and explained my delemma but was informed there were no appointments available and the 21 march was pencilled in. Mean while I attended the practice to ask for a repeat prescription of co-codamol because I had run out.Then in the early hours of 12/3/24 I called 111 and spoke to staff as I was in severe pain unfortunately no one got back to me until 1500 later that day, however earlier at 0800 I phoned the practice and asked for an emergency appointment, I explained my pain and the steps I had gone through. I was told my request for naproxen would be sent to the practice pharmacist and to ring later in the afternoon no appointment was offered. I called back in the afternoon and was told the pharmacist was on annual leave and the request had been sent to a doctor. Still with no pain medication or naproxen I contacted 111 again who were very helpful. This afternoon I was contacted by my chemist to say the medication was available. Meanwhile for the last 2 days I have been in sever pain with no medication or help from the practice at all. And later in the afternoon a doctor from the practice contacted me after a 111 request but by then thankfully I had my medication. I think your response to request for help was extremely poor and I can only thank the 111 system for their *** Disappointing Experience at Kingsway Medical Practice****

I recently had a very disappointing experience at Kingsway Medical Practice, and I feel compelled to share my thoughts and concerns.

Firstly, the staff receptionist were incredibly rude and unhelpful. I approached them with a simple query, but instead of providing assistance, they seemed disinterested and dismissive. Their lack of professionalism was truly disheartening.

Furthermore, it is important to note that Kingsway Medical Practice makes it nearly impossible to have a face-to-face consultation with a doctor. The receptionists consistently provide evasive answers and display an unhelpful tone of voice. Instead of prioritizing in-person appointments, they frequently push for telephonic consultations, which are far less effective in addressing medical concerns. This approach leaves patients feeling unheard and frustrated, as it seems like the practice is intentionally avoiding addressing the actual issues at hand.

Moreover, the doctors themselves seemed rushed and uninterested in providing thorough care. During my appointments, I felt like I was being rushed through, with minimal attention given to my concerns. It is disheartening to see healthcare professionals who lack empathy and fail to prioritize patient well-being.

Moreover, it is worth mentioning that it is nearly impossible to meet with a doctor face to face at Kingsway Medical Practice. The receptionists consistently provide runaround answers and have an unhelpful tone of voice. Instead of scheduling in-person consultations, they often opt for telephonic appointments, which are not as effective in addressing medical concerns. It feels as though they are intentionally avoiding addressing the actual issues at hand, leaving patients feeling unheard and frustrated.

Overall, my experience at Kingsway Medical Practice was extremely disappointing. The unhelpful staff, long waiting times, lack of attentive care from doctors, and poor hygiene standards all contribute to a negative impression of this practice. I strongly urge others to consider alternative healthcare providers in order to receive the quality care they deserve.
**********Not recommended at all****",null,[0,99]]]],[null,1688720588000000,1688720588000000,"2 years ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/539622197010711189/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTkthalpxUzBsbkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/539622197010711189/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTkthalpxUzBsbkVBRRAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/539622197010711189/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTkthalpxUzBsbkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/539622197010711189/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTkthalpxUzBsbkVBRRAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/539622197010711189/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTkthalpxUzBsbkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/539622197010711189/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTkthalpxUzBsbkVBRRAA"],null,["en"],[["Hello and thank you for bringing this to my attention and I am disappointed to read that you feel the care you have received from us is not good nor that the clinicians you have consulted with here have been uncaring and that the building is unhygienic. waiting - WAIT to get the appointment because there are never any available so you have to WAIT til the next morning to try and get one at 9pm when new available slots are released. Then when you call, you can end up WAITing for nothing as the appointments go so quick.

When I finally get an appointment, I have to wait to get checked in because the computer check in screen isn't working. Then on top of this I have to wait at least an hour for the doctor to see me, only to be rushed out half the time and advised to take medication that costs the NHS less to produce.

Most the doctors just care about getting you in & out of their 10 minute slot so they don't get even later. Why they don't allocate longer time slots for appointments to reduce waiting times I do not know.

"One problem per appointment" I've been told by a few doctors now. You'd think a doctor out of all professions would consider the possibility that all symptoms a patient has link together. But no, it's too much for them (Dr. Bowley in particular) to even skim read through the medical notes let alone consider all possibilities.
